subject: Governor sanity probes and rollback escrow plan for on-prem cutover
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com, ops-eng@helios-systems.com, sre@helios-systems.com
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Governor sanity probes and rollback escrow plan for on-prem cutover

Team / Helios SREs —

We’re scheduled for the private deployment cutover to the Helios VPC this Friday 08/06 (activation window 02:00-06:00 UTC). Before we hit greenlight I want a short, focused readiness check that covers three risk buckets: networking ACLs and NAT/peering, service discovery + KV cache warmup, and an operational rollback escrow with clear signoff owners.

Please see the attached Governor sanity probes doc (v1.2) which distills the smoke tests into a 12-point run (network traceroutes/ACL verification, control-plane reachability, KV priming, prefix cache validation, policy-based routing checks, and synthetic low-latency inference probes). I’ve also attached a KV warmup checklist and a draft rollback escrow signoff doc.

Asks before end-of-day today (EOD PDT):
- Helios SREs: confirm ACL rule ids and whether your NAT gateway is asymmetrical for the control plane (reply with rule ids and NAT behavior).
- Irene: can Platform own the KV priming window (20m) and the consumer-side warmup script? We need to run it 45m before traffic swap.
- Aditya: I’ll need the exact fallback image tag and the automated rollback play command for the escrow doc.
- Laura: please coordinate with Legal/CS if the escrow signoff needs a second approver for enterprise customers (Helios contract) — we want signoff timeboxed to 30 minutes.

Also: suggest we do a short 30-minute ops safety brief Thursday 17:00 PDT to walk through the probes and who hits which steps. If Helios can provide a contact who will be on-call in the window (name and pager) add them to the thread.

No surprises — keep replies terse and list items.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Site Reliability & Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-governor-sanity-probes-v1.2.pdf (runbook), kv-warmup-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet), rollback-escrow-signoff.docx (template)

From: Jordan Lee <ops-eng@helios-systems.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: sre@helios-systems.com (Maya Patel)
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Governor sanity probes and rollback escrow plan for on-prem cutover

Marissa —

Thanks for the concise callout. Quick confirmations from Helios SRE: 
- ACLs: inbound control-plane rules are ACL-7341/ACL-7342 (control-plane in CIDR 10.240.0.0/23). Egress for inference workers to model storage goes via NAT-GW-3 which is stateful, not asymmetrical. We’ll paste full rule dump to the Drive folder in 30m.
- We will provide an on-call contact for the window: Maya Patel (pager M-+1-415-555-0199).
- For routing: we already have a policy-based route (PBR-02) for the model cache network; there’s a known micro-burst issue with BGP hold-time during heavy parallel downloads — we will throttle concurrency to 8 streams during the warmup per your checklist.

We’ll run the traceroute/ACL verification at 16:00 PDT today and post results to the Drive link. 

Jordan Lee
Ops Engineering Lead
Helios Systems

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com, ops-eng@helios-systems.com
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Governor sanity probes and rollback escrow plan for on-prem cutover

Marissa —

I can take ownership of KV priming. Proposed plan:
- T-45m: Platform runs cold-warm script (kv-warmup-checklist.xlsx) against a pinned model keyspace. Script will use low-concurrency (4 threads) to avoid saturating Helios' storage network.
- T-25m: Run synthetic inference probes (10 questions, 3 concurrency) to validate KV hit rate > 90% and token latency 95th percentile < 120ms.
- T-15m: Signal "primed" to Ops bridge with the warmup results CSV attached.

I’ll need Aditya’s rollback command so the escrow doc contains the exact CLI to execute (and the account that can escalate). Also flagged: the warmup script needs a bucket credential which Helios will supply to my team via encrypted transfer.

Irene Choi
Platform Reliability Manager
Redwood Inference

Short update and rollback CLI for escrow doc (see attached draft):

Rollback command (automated, idempotent):
- /opt/redwood/opsctl rollback --deployment helios-vpc --tag redwood-prod-20270805-rollback --force --timeout 900
- Expected window to complete: 6-12 minutes (we’ve validated in staging at scale).

Escrow signoff owners (proposed):
- Primary signoff: Helios Ops (Maya Patel) -> validate traffic drain and control-plane reattach.
- Secondary signoff: Redwood Ops (Aditya Rao) -> execute rollback CLI and confirm artifact rollback.
- Legal/CS acknowledgement: Laura Bennett (time-limited acknowledgement acceptable).

Irene: I attached a short snippet that triggers the priming lambda with the right bucket credential name. Helios — please provision the credential 'helios-priming-bucket:read-only' and share the key via the secure transfer link on Drive.

I’m good for the 17:00 PDT safety brief and will run through the rollback exercise live for 10 minutes.

Aditya Rao
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference

Marissa
